title: Emergent Misalignment Rate Variation Across Evaluation Prompt Categories

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful but primarily an analysis contribution rather than a new finding. Understanding which prompt categories are most vulnerable informs evaluation efficiency, but the causal link to safety improvement is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: No new training required. Uses existing fine-tuned models and published evaluation prompts. Only requires inference and manual categorization. Highly accessible for beginners. Minimal compute needs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single task: run inference on existing model, categorize prompts, compute per-category rates. Clear deliverable: a breakdown table. Well within 30 hours. The optional second step (comparing triggers) can be dropped.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
